course_comparison.neet_vs_jee: NEET-UG program is tailored for medical aspirants with intensive focus on NCERT Biology (Zoology & Botany), Physics, and Chemistry. JEE program focuses on advanced mathematical proofs, calculus, physical mechanics, and multi-concept problem solving for IIT entrance.
course_comparison.dropper_vs_integrated: The 2-Year Integrated Program synchronizes with Class 11 & 12 board syllabi, while the Dropper Batch is a fast-paced 1-year program focused purely on entrance syllabus revision and high-frequency test series.
course_comparison.foundation_benefit: Starting in Class 9 or 10 through our Foundation Program builds analytical problem-solving skills early, giving students a 2-year head start before entering Class 11 competition.

Step 4: Complete admission paperwork and pay fees via one-time discount or flexible 3-installment interest-free plan.
documents_required: Photocopy of Class 10th / previous academic marksheet
Aadhaar card or valid government identity proof (student & parent)
ATSE Scholarship test scorecard / admit card

faq.question: What courses do you offer?
faq.answer: ABC Academy offers specialized coaching for NEET and JEE: 2-Year Integrated NEET (Class 11-12), 2-Year Integrated JEE (Class 11-12), 1-Year NEET Droppers Batch, 1-Year JEE Droppers Batch, and Class 9-10 Foundation & Olympiad programs. [Sample Demo Data]

faq.question: What are the course fees?
faq.answer: Sample Demo Fees: 2-Year JEE is approx ₹1,45,000/yr; 2-Year NEET is approx ₹1,35,000/yr; 1-Year Dropper batches are ₹90,000-₹95,000; and Foundation (Class 9/10) is ₹48,000/yr. Up to 90% scholarship is available through our ATSE scholarship test, and 3-month zero-interest installments are accepted. (Note: These are sample demo estimates).

faq.question: What are the batch timings?
faq.answer: We offer flexible timings: Morning Batches (8:00 AM - 12:30 PM), Evening Batches (4:00 PM - 7:30 PM), and Weekend Batches (Sat 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM, Sun 8:30 AM - 2:00 PM). Droppers batches run Monday to Friday from 8:30 AM to 3:00 PM.

faq.question: Do you offer scholarship tests?
faq.answer: Yes! We conduct the ABC Talent Scholarship Exam (ATSE), where students can earn up to 90% tuition fee waiver based on their performance in Science, Maths, and Logical Aptitude.

faq.question: Can I attend demo or trial classes before enrolling?
faq.answer: Yes! ABC Academy offers 2 free trial/demo classes so students can experience our faculty teaching methodology and doubt support before formal admission.

faq.question: Do you offer separate batches for 12th pass / dropper students?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer dedicated full-time 1-Year Dropper/Repeater cohorts for both NEET-UG (Achiever Batch) and JEE (Rank Booster Cohort) with daily 6-hour rigorous instruction and testing.

faq.question: How do doubt-clearing sessions work?
faq.answer: We have dedicated Doubt Clearing Desks open daily from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM where students can sit 1-on-1 with expert faculty to resolve tricky questions and test errors.

faq.question: Do you provide hostel or transport facilities?
faq.answer: ABC Academy provides tie-up verified hostel recommendations with dedicated study environments within 1 km of campus, along with optional daily AC bus transport across major city routes. [Sample demo info]

faq.question: Can someone call me for admission guidance?
faq.answer: Yes! If you share your name and phone number (or click 'Request Callback'), our senior academic counselor will call you within 24 business hours to discuss batch options, scholarship tests, and preparation strategy.

faq.question: What happens if a student misses a lecture?
faq.answer: All classroom lectures are recorded in high-definition and uploaded to the online student portal within 24 hours, along with annotated teacher notes and assignment sheets.
